span.p:
LoadBalancer path
cloud LB or MetalLB
external IP on 443

div.style: color: rgb(77, 45, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
NodePort path
any node on 30443
set agent.publicPort to match

div.style: color: rgb(36, 41, 47) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Service k8s-agent-session-proxy
type LoadBalancer or NodePort
externalTrafficPolicy Local keeps client IPs

div.style: color: rgb(15, 83, 35) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
session-proxy pods
port 4444 · HTTPS
TLS TERMINATES HERE
serves kasm-session-proxy-tls

div.style: color: rgb(76, 40, 137) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(87, 96, 106) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Nothing speaks HTTP on this path.
Raise the LB's L4 idle timeout to 3600s
— an AWS NLB defaults to 350s

div.style: color: rgb(87, 96, 106) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PROXY protocol variant
the LB prepends a PROXY header and
agent.sessionProxy.proxyProtocol.enabled=true
then EVERY connection must carry it

svg.text: NodePort and LoadBalancer — Layer 4 straight to the session proxy
